name: Kitchener / Vaughan; formerly Kitchener / Bramalea
description: A Kitchener–Bramalea train-connection express that gained all-day/weekend service and Waterloo university connections.

timeline.event: Route 30 already appears with one weekday morning eastbound trip and three westbound train meets.
Weekday counter-peak and off-peak service was added.
Ontario described expanded all-day Kitchener–Bramalea express service alongside Highway 401 bus-shoulder improvements.
The route extended from Kitchener GO to Waterloo and Laurier universities.
Weekend service was added for connections to new weekend Kitchener-line trains.

sources.title: GO Kitchener table 31, effective 6 April 2013, routes 30 / 31 / 33 / 39
Metrolinx GO Transit Ridership Report, September 2016 (original report, archived by Steve Munro)
Ontario adding GO bus by-pass shoulders on Highway 401, 26 September 2016
Metrolinx announces increased weekday service across GO network, 26 August 2021
GO Transit: April service changes, published 14 April 2023

gaps: Route 30 existed by 2013; the 2016 expansion was not its launch.
Initial introduction and later Highway 407-terminal extension dates need primary notices.
Kitchener GO and Charles Street terminal are distinct places.
